name: C++
description: Modern C++ from classes and RAII through the STL, templates, move semantics and performance work.

nodes.name: C++ basics
nodes.desc: Types, I/O streams, namespaces, std::string and how C++ extends C.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write simple C++ programs using types, I/O streams, namespaces and std::string, and explain how C++ extends C.

nodes.name: References & pointers
nodes.desc: References, const correctness, pointers and passing by value or reference.
nodes.summary: You will be able to choose between references, pointers and values when passing data and apply const correctness.
topics: Passing by value, reference and const reference

nodes.name: Overloading
nodes.desc: Function overloading, default arguments and inline functions.
nodes.summary: You will be able to overload functions, use default arguments and understand how overload resolution and inline functions work.

nodes.name: Classes
nodes.desc: Classes, access control, constructors, member functions and static members.
nodes.summary: You will be able to define classes with access control, constructors, member functions and static members.

nodes.name: RAII & destructors
nodes.desc: Destructors, the rule of three/five and tying resource lifetime to object lifetime.
nodes.summary: You will be able to tie resource lifetime to object lifetime with destructors and apply the rule of three and rule of five.
topics: Rule of three and rule of five

nodes.name: Operator overloading
nodes.desc: Overloading arithmetic, comparison, stream and subscript operators sensibly.
nodes.summary: You will be able to overload arithmetic, comparison, stream and subscript operators in a way that matches user expectations.

nodes.name: Inheritance & virtual
nodes.desc: Inheritance, virtual functions, vtables and abstract base classes.
nodes.summary: You will be able to use inheritance and virtual functions for runtime polymorphism and explain how vtables implement it.
topics: Pure virtual functions and abstract classes

nodes.name: Templates
nodes.desc: Function and class templates, template argument deduction and specialisation.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write function and class templates and understand template argument deduction and specialisation.

nodes.name: STL containers
nodes.desc: vector, deque, list, map, unordered_map, set and their complexity guarantees.
nodes.summary: You will be able to choose the right STL container for a task based on its operations and complexity guarantees.
topics: map and set as balanced trees

nodes.name: Iterators & algorithms
nodes.desc: Iterator categories and the <algorithm> library: sort, find, transform and friends.
nodes.summary: You will be able to use iterator categories and the algorithm library to sort, search and transform data without hand-written loops.

nodes.name: Text indexer project
nodes.desc: Build a word index over a set of files with STL containers and fast lookups.
nodes.summary: You will build a word index over a set of files using STL containers for fast lookups and ranked results.

nodes.name: Move semantics
nodes.desc: Rvalue references, move constructors, std::move and perfect forwarding.
nodes.summary: You will be able to use rvalue references, move constructors, std::move and perfect forwarding to avoid unnecessary copies.

nodes.name: Smart pointers
nodes.desc: unique_ptr, shared_ptr and weak_ptr and when to use each.
nodes.summary: You will be able to manage heap objects with unique_ptr, shared_ptr and weak_ptr and choose the right one for each ownership model.

nodes.name: Lambdas
nodes.desc: Lambda expressions, captures, std::function and functional style with algorithms.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write lambda expressions with captures, store them in std::function and use them with STL algorithms.
topics: Capture by value and by reference

nodes.name: std::thread
nodes.desc: std::thread, mutexes, condition variables, atomics and futures.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write concurrent C++ with std::thread, mutexes, condition variables, atomics and futures.

nodes.name: Build & CMake
nodes.desc: Compilation units, linking, headers and building projects with CMake.
nodes.summary: You will be able to organise code into headers and compilation units and build multi-file projects with CMake.

nodes.name: UB & sanitizers
nodes.desc: Common undefined behaviour and catching it with AddressSanitizer and UBSan.
nodes.summary: You will be able to recognise common undefined behaviour in C++ and catch it with AddressSanitizer and UBSan.

nodes.name: Profiling
nodes.desc: Measuring performance, cache-friendly data layout and profilers.
nodes.summary: You will be able to measure C++ performance with profilers and improve it with cache-friendly data layouts.
topics: Struct of arrays versus array of structs

nodes.name: Matrix library project
nodes.desc: Write a generic matrix class with operators, move semantics and benchmarks.
nodes.summary: You will write a generic matrix class with overloaded operators and move semantics, and benchmark its performance.
